title: Claude turned my free Nanite for unity app into a Terminator..
author: Big_Presentation2786
selftext:
I've been making a free Nanite program for Unity the last few months.

Over at the Unity sub one person suggested I test it with Claude. I couldn't help but ask Claude if there were any improvements it might make..

It rebuilt the app into a Terminator..

I even added a theme tune and started laughing out loud as I heard it..

Now I see why everyone 'hates AI' this is where the money tree lives..

It feels like cheatin'.. I love it..

Gonna have to rename my program AIomise! 😀

Can't wait to finish this so I can give it away, should be done in not time now..

replies.author: Big_Presentation2786
replies.body:
I mean, the whole package didn't take that long, you can see my YouTube where I implemented each step.


Nanite is quite old technology now- even Unreal are looking towards mass entity (dots in Unity), I was able to use a HiZ culling' script to first cluster then cull a mesh, then I built a BVH back end from the Trellis script and linked that to a renderer that could compress shapes.
Each step is on my YouTube.
All the components were available on GitHub, I just put them in the right order.


NADE or as the new AI version is called AIOMISE (gotta give a node to AI 😏) is 90% Nanite, 10% something else.


I built NADE for the people -open source. AIOMISE is the supercharged version for Vibe Coders. Both will be free and open source, but with help from AI AIOMISE will give all vibe coders and edge in the game..


All your scenes will be faster than those who don't want the Vibe Code version..

replies.author: Big_Presentation2786
replies.body:
Oh it doesn't bother me in the slightest, Nano-Tech doesn't exist anymore. It was sold to an AI startup


Here's the effort they put into there website 


www.render-dreams.ai


If you see the most recent video it was producing 4.5 million triangles from roughly 30 thousand cluster's at 120FPS.


When you use the optimum clustering number per object 64, that gives us an instance count of 3000 objects for that scene.


NADE or AIOMISE as it's now called thanks to AI, can render 120 million Instances dynamically at only 548 clusters at 35000 triangles at 120FPS.


Technically they're exactly the same product.


Hypothetically, AIOMISE is a more effective optimiser according to the Nano-Techs videos..
But..


Nano-Tech was built by a graphics programmer over 4 years aimed at the mobile market and was expected to be on sale at £150, AIOMISE was built by an indie dev, over 2 weeks and is gonna be free to vibe Coders..


NADE's still gonna be free for none vibe coders too.. it just won't be as good as the vibe code version..


Hope this helps bro

replies.author: CaptainKahler
replies.body:
Hi here is the dev of NanoTech, Chris!   
Your info is NOT true and you should not spread false news, the investor at that time thought it is a good idea to use an "ai" ending as a website ending, the website is still under construction btw. we are not an "AI company".   
I'm still the CEO of the company and have 50% shares. I don't think your NADE (or AIOMISE) version will be as good as NanoTech in many aspects, but we will see what a 2 weeks product can do vs a product that has been in development for years... btw. mobile maket is also not the main target.  
  
Additionally, you should watch out, if you use Unreal's source code you will get yourself and other users that use your code into legal troubles with EpicGames but I guess you just used AI? NanoTech Code is complete written on my own and does not contain any code from Epic Games, but I also use AI lately to improve and refactor the code. It would be silly to complete avoid AI, but I wouldn't say that we are an AI company if we use AI as a supporting tool. It sounds like you are mainly used AI to build your system?  
  
Also your description doesn't make sense, what do you mean with "instances"? objects or triangles or clusters?  
I guess you meant 120 triangles transformed by your system to 548 clusters at 35000 triangles? If your system is mainly relying on AI, I don't think it can hold up to the improvements I implemented in NanoTech as AI has it limits too. But again we will see :-) challange accepted.  
  
 But please stop using false statements, thanks!

replies.author: Big_Presentation2786
replies.body:
Hey big man.


Sadly, no one cares about 'Nanite for Unity's..


Your investor probably wanted to piggy back off the marketing/hype of AI before the whole thing took a turn..
It's actually a smart idea and if you embrace it rather than hiding from it, you'll probably corner a large part of the vibe coding market that's surging in huge growth, instead of alienating yourself from them, why do you think he gave you his money? Listen to him..


>but I also use AI lately to improve and refactor the code. It would be silly to completely avoid AI, but I wouldn't say that we are an AI company if we use AI as a supporting tool.


You're using AI to support you code, I think that's smart! That's like a tradesmen using a power tool..

Firstly, NADE is a month old. 
I'm not expecting calls from the big leagues- I made it to show it could be made.
That's it.. I genuinely don't care about it, I CAN NOT wait to move on to my old stuff..


NADE wasn't made from AI, it was simply made from finding a QEM simplifier on GitHub- and then dropping a Trellis BVH among other stuff you need to build one, the pieces are all there and waiting, everything is MIT licensed repos.. it's been analysed by Claude thanks to a user suggesting to test it against Nanite, I asked Claude for Upgrades and it made a new version which I call AIOMISE, the AI Atomiser..


AIOMISE is AI! And oh my god it's quick bro.. We've a number of changes implemented by AI that improves the whole user experience..
That means AIOMISE should be the Vibe Coders best friend!


Do you know how excited I am to release AIOMISE? 


..I don't care


If you don't want people to take 'incorrect' context from your .AI website, increase your social presence and maintain your image..


Otherwise one day you'll walk into a bank wearing a mask and wonder why the panic alarms are going off..

replies.author: Big_Presentation2786
replies.body:
> it's a bit weird that you spend weeks working on that, but you don't actually care


It's a matter of principles. A kid (of whom can be seen in my YouTube videos), belittled me when I explained how this would work, he stated arrogantly and petulantly this method couldn't and wouldn't work..
Then he doxxed me and threatened me unless I stopped building it, and I don't like bullies..


For me this was a challenge, and when I finished it, I instantly became bored.. it's not taken me weeks, ive built this part time. I reckon a total of 12 days in man hours, as I've stated- all the pieces are on GitHub with MIT licenses..
Hell, looking through the files- I've noticed most of the scripts Id used had been written with AI.


>there were already other people showing that it is possible to make Nanite for Unity


You're right- I told this the kid..
If I had a penny for every time I've told someone how simple this was to build, I'd be able to retire. I've no idea why people assume this is difficult.
You're literally preaching to the choir.


>if it really has all the features and is not a cheap copy of the original


Who cares? It's free..


I'm fairly certain AIOMISE could be built by anyone with a basic AI and an understanding of HDRP.


Look at NYX, the exact same setup, made by a guy with AI.


>then you have my respect.


Cheers, if you just hadn't called me weird, this might have meant something.
